title: RIMS Security Personnel Allegedly Assaulted While on Duty; Authorities Condemn Incident
summary: RIMS security personnel Salam Suresh Singh was reportedly assaulted by unidentified individuals while on duty. RIMS authorities condemn the incident and call for investigation.
body:
A security personnel posted at the Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS), Imphal, was reportedly assaulted by unidentified individuals while performing his duty at the RT area of the hospital.

The security personnel has been identified as Salam Suresh Singh.

The incident has drawn strong condemnation from RIMS authorities, who expressed concern over the physical assault of a security personnel while he was on duty at the hospital.

RIMS authorities stated that the institution is a hospital meant for treating patients and stressed that violence within its premises is unacceptable.

They further stated that the incident would be investigated with the assistance of law enforcement authorities to ensure that those involved are identified and face appropriate punishment in accordance with the law.

The authorities reiterated their commitment to maintaining a safe environment for patients, healthcare workers, staff and security personnel within the hospital premises.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
